compute_sari_score: compute the SARI score for evaluating automatic text simplification systems given sources, predictions, and references
calculate_sari_gram_scores: calculate n-gram keep, delete, and add F1/precision scores for a single sentence pair using SARI grammar
normalize_sentence: normalize a sentence with optional lowercasing and configurable tokenization for SARI metric preprocessing
evaluate_sari_metric: evaluate text simplification predictions against multiple references using the Sari metric class
get_sari_metric_info: retrieve metadata, features, citation, and reference URLs for the SARI evaluation metric
